tspan.tspan: Est.: of ~$4.8M spent on a GB300 NVL72 rack + network, NVIDIA keeps ~$2.3M as GPU gross profit
Where the dollars go, US$ M · rack price $3.99M (Morgan Stanley, May 2026) + ~$0.8M scale-out network/storage (SemiAnalysis GB200 basis) · GPU cost on Epoch AI B200 basis
